stem.text: An outdoor concert has two large speakers beside the stage for broadcasting music.
In order to test the speakers, they are made to emit sound of the same wavelength and the same amplitude.
The curved lines in the diagram represent wavefronts.
Where is the loudest sound heard?

stem.alt: Circular wavefronts spreading from two speakers on a stage, with points labelled A, B, C and D and the labels speakers and stage.
